points.name: egress broker
points.note: egress::decide takes a request and a destination catalog and no revocation input at all; this task does not give it one (Task 7.7)

not_covered: does not propagate to any other machine or any other process: no fan-out, no broker and no replica set is linked, so every latency here is this process's own
does not recall a credential already used; revocation bounds future use only
does not reach a copy of the credential held by a third party
does not close a session already open, terminate a process, or drop a socket
does not bind an agent that never asks for a verdict: the refusal is a chokepoint, not an operating-system bound

does not reach a second store on the SAME machine: the journal is a file under one store root, `--root` is accepted on every command, and a report built against a different root reads a different file

does not bind a revoked string to an issued identity: `grant --subject` and `revoke --svid` both accept arbitrary strings and this build mints no SVID document, so the default subject is a constant, not an issued SVID, until Task 3.1 lands
